#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 998244353;

ll mod_add(ll a, ll b) {
    ll res = a + b;
    if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
    return res;
}

ll mod_mul(ll a, ll b) {
    return (a * b) % MOD;
}

ll mod_pow(ll x, int e) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) res = mod_mul(res, x);
        x = mod_mul(x, x);
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

ll mod_inv(ll x) {
    ll g = MOD, r = x, y = 0, t;
    ll a = 0, b = 1;
    while (r != 0) {
        ll q = g / r;
        t = g % r;
        g = r;
        r = t;
        t = a - q * b;
        a = b;
        b = t;
    }
    assert(g == 1);
    if (a < 0) a += MOD;
    return a;
}

vector<ll> fact, inv_fact;

void precompute_fact(int n) {
    fact.resize(n + 1);
    inv_fact.resize(n + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        fact[i] = mod_mul(fact[i - 1], i);
    }
    inv_fact[n] = mod_inv(fact[n]);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        inv_fact[i] = mod_mul(inv_fact[i + 1], i + 1);
    }
}

ll nCr(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    return mod_mul(fact[n], mod_mul(inv_fact[r], inv_fact[n - r]));
}

ll parity_sign(ll k) {
    return (k & 1) ? MOD - 1 : 1;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    ll k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    if (k == 0) {
        precompute_fact(n);
        cout << fact[n] << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    if (k > n - 1) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    int c = (int)(n - k);
    precompute_fact(n);

    ll answer = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= c; ++i) {
        ll term = mod_mul(parity_sign(c - i), nCr(c, i));
        term = mod_mul(term, mod_pow(i, n));
        answer = mod_add(answer, term);
    }

    answer = mod_mul(answer, 2);
    answer = mod_mul(answer, nCr(n, c));
    cout << answer << '\n';

    return 0;
}
